tripodeHoy.pregunta: Are you bringing the tripod today?

avisos.seguridad: Go out while there is light, bring a flashlight and, if the viewpoint is isolated, tell someone where you are going.
avisos.seguridadAmanecer: You are going out in low light: bring a flashlight and, if the viewpoint is isolated, tell someone where you are going.
avisos.sol: Never look at the sun through the camera viewfinder, especially with a telephoto lens: it can damage your eyesight.
avisos.formato: If you won't be editing your photos, shoot them in [[jpeg|JPEG]]. If you want to learn to edit, use [[raw|RAW]].
